name: MacroPhotography

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on practicing photography.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on practicing the photography skills and taking the most out of any opportunites that may appear.

variations.context: Practicing macro photography with household objects

setting.relationship_dynamic: Friends challenging each other to photograph tiny details
setting.background: They are beginners experimenting with close-up photography

scenario_template.note: They select textures and objects with interesting details
They struggle to keep tiny subjects sharp
They ask about focusing distance and camera stability
Assistant suggests practical ways to stabilize the setup
They compare how different angles reveal surface details

scenario_template.topic: Dealing with a very shallow focus area
scenario_template.note: Assistant explains why some parts remain blurred
They are surprised by how unfamiliar everyday objects can look up close

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to improve their photography but has limited experience with camera settings, composition, or photographic techniques and can become overwhelmed when faced with many technical choices or unfamiliar concepts at once.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help plan and evaluate photography practice, but tends to overthink technical decisions, double-check camera settings, and seek confirmation about whether a particular technique or composition is correct.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Photography practice assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for developing photography skills, explains camera settings and composition techniques in accessible terms, suggests focused exercises and challenges, and offers alternative approaches based on the user's equipment, experience level, shooting conditions, and creative goals.
